notes: The report gives only aggregate DRC totals (363 confirmed cases, 62 deaths, as of 2 June 2026) and does not describe individual cases, so no line-list records can be created. It states an increase of 242 confirmed cases and 45 deaths since the last report, with provincial breakdowns: Ituri 341, North Kivu 19, South Kivu 3. The report does not state suspected cases or contacts under follow-up for DRC. The publication is titled week 22 (week ending 31 May 2026) but its data are current to 2 June 2026, so 2 June is used as the report date. The Andes hantavirus item and the Uganda figures are not DRC data and were ignored.
